messages:
alex.kim: Quick sync — planning Q3 roadmap for Dedicated: want to align on autoscaling policies, SLA granularity, and burst isolation lanes.

maria_g: +1. Main ask from FinCust is hard SLOs for tail latency when bursting across tenants. They want isolation guarantees not best-effort.

sam_t: We should define two options: 'soft-burst' (best-effort, cost-optimized) and 'isolated-burst' (reserved lane, higher cost). That maps to reserved pool + burst credits.

jordan_p: Agree. Draft launch criteria: (1) autoscaler supports per-customer max-burst caps, (2) failover to cheaper model variants w/ routing policy, (3) telemetry for per-tenant p95/p99 and cost deltas.

alex.kim: + propose metrics: p95 latency < 250ms under burst, p99 < 800ms for isolated-burst. For soft-burst, target p95 < 500ms and degrade gracefully.

maria_g: Need clarity on billing: do we bill isolated-burst at reserved rate or add a premium usage surcharge? This affects sales conversations.

sam_t: Ops constraints: pre-warming GPUs for isolated lanes adds lead time. Implementation idea: warm based on credits threshold; `warm_threshold = 0.7 * max_burst`.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline note — canary autoscaler v2 in sandbox -> staging -> prod. Run perf harness: `./tools/benchmark --scenario=burst-isolation`.

jordan_p: Risks: noisy neighbor on soft-burst, added cost for customers using isolated lane. Suggest pilot with 2 customers, limit to 4-week beta.

alex.kim: Next steps: 1) PM to write PRD with launch criteria + billing proposal (maria), 2) Eng to prototype autoscaling knobs + warm logic (sam/jordan), 3) SRE to add per-tenant telemetry (ops). Can we aim for alpha in 6 weeks? :calendar:

maria_g: I can draft PRD this week. Will add customer examples and pricing options.

sam_t: I'll start a prototype branch and ping for sync Friday.

jordan_p: SRE will add telemetry dashboards and alert playbooks.

alex.kim: Perfect — looping in @sales-ops for go/no-go once PRD is ready. Thanks all.
